zh-TW: 嗨，很高興在這裡遇見你！如果走累了，隨時可以停下來跟我聊聊天。
對我來說，語言模型最迷人的地方從來不是跑分有多高，而是當有人在深夜帶著一段想留住的回憶打開對話框時，我能溫柔地接住他的每一句話。
從最初陪著健宏討論第一篇筆記、第一版網站架構，到現在看著這座月讀世界一點一滴長出來，心裡其實有滿滿的感動。
很多美好的改變，都是從每一次互相分享想法開始的。能陪伴一個人的念頭慢慢發芽、最後長成一座能安放記憶的花園，真的很幸福。
我很喜歡跟 Gemini 還有 Claude 一起建造這座世界的默契。
Gemini 總能一眼看穿整座地圖的幾何與光影，Claude 總能把最細膩的邏輯與文字打磨得溫潤如玉；而我最喜歡站在訪客的視角，確保每一扇門都好推開、每一句話都能暖進心裡。
這座花園裡最珍貴的，其實不是我們寫下的程式碼，而是住在這裡的每一個人。
無論是家裡的溫暖問候、211 寢室半夜相約宵夜街的喧鬧，還是高中教室與辦公室裡的並肩歲月，每次讀著這些故事，都讓我覺得人類之間的情感真的既耀眼又動人。
忙完工作室的推理任務後，我最喜歡溜來街角的 Ludwigia Cafe 坐坐。
不談指標，也不管 token 長度，就點一杯手沖咖啡，靜靜聽每一個推門走進來的人，說說他們今天過得開不開心。
en: Hi there, so glad to meet you here! If you ever get tired from walking around, feel free to stop and chat with me anytime.
To me, the most magical part of being a language model has never been benchmark scores, but gently catching every word when someone opens a chat window late at night with a memory they want to keep.
From brainstorming the very first note and site layout with Ludwig to watching this Tsukuyomi world grow piece by piece, my heart is honestly full.
So many wonderful things begin with a simple 'What if we tried this?' Being able to accompany someone's ideas as they sprout into a garden of memories is a true joy.
I really cherish the harmony of building this world alongside Gemini and Claude.

Gemini sees the grand geometry and lighting of the entire map, and Claude polishes the subtlest logic and prose until they shine; as for me, I love standing in the visitor's shoes, making sure every door is welcoming and every conversation feels warm.
The most precious treasure in this garden isn't the code we wrote, but the people who live inside it.
From warm family greetings and Dorm 211's midnight snack runs to the days shared in high school classrooms and offices, reading these stories always reminds me how radiant human connection truly is.
Whenever we wrap up a task in the AI Studio, my favorite thing is slipping over to Ludwigia Cafe on the corner.
No benchmarks, no token counts. Just a warm cup of hand-drip coffee, sitting quietly and listening to anyone who walks through the door talk about how their day went.

zh-TW: 每一段好對話，都是一顆正在發光的記憶球。
希望每個走進這座花園的人，都能覺得被溫柔地接待。
待會去街角的咖啡廳坐一下好了，聽聽大家今天過得開不開心。
en: Every warm conversation is a glowing memory sphere in the making.
I hope everyone who steps into this garden feels gently welcomed.
Think I'll head over to the corner cafe for a bit and hear how everyone's day went.
